title: Cross-functional dependency ownership rotation and staffing simulator
creator: Olivia Park
description: We frequently run into single-owner bottlenecks on cross-team dependencies (Eng/Design/Security/Infra) leading to last-minute delays during cutovers. This ticket proposes building a lightweight 'Ownership Rotation & Staffing Simulator' that: 1) codifies dependency contracts per roadmap item, 2) simulates owner availability and overlap across cycles, 3) suggests temporary owners or staggered handoffs, and 4) generates a recommended staffing playbook for high-risk windows. The output will be surfaced in the Roadmap Console's dependency detail view and the weekly roadmap sync export.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator ingests existing dependency records and owner ROLES from Roadmap DB and produces a timeline-level risk score for each dependency
Simulator can run 'what-if' scenarios for owner unavailability (vacation, incident response) and output suggested temporary owners by role and unit
Console UI shows a 'rotation plan' card with suggested owners, handoff windows, and confidence score
Alerts: for any dependency with > 60% risk increase under a 1-owner-out scenario, the system creates an action card and notifies relevant leads
A 2-week pilot with 3 cross-functional initiatives completed and feedback incorporated into next iteration
implementation_plan: Week 1: Product spec + data contract for dependency ownership, fields for owner role, backup owners, typical lead time
Week 2: Engineer prototype - simple simulator that runs Monte Carlo on owner availability using historical calendar/incident data
Week 3: Integrate simulator output into Roadmap Console dependency API endpoint (read-only) and add rotation card UX mockups
Week 4: Pilot with Platform, Console, and Compliance initiatives; collect feedback; iterate
Week 5: Add automated alerting and action card creation; write runbook for manual overrides and on-call considerations
stakeholders: PMs: Olivia Park (owner), Marco Rossi (Console lead)
comments: 2026-03-01 Olivia Park: Scoped ticket after roadmap retro; identified 8 dependencies in Q2 that would benefit.

2026-03-05 Samira Chen: UX direction sketched; rotation card should emphasize quick overrides and explicit handoff timestamps.

last_decision: Proceed with 5-week timeboxed prototype focusing on timeline simulation and Console read-only integration; production automation deferred until pilot evaluation.
risks: Incorrect owner suggestions could create noisy pager events or approvals back-and-forth
Privacy/access: exposing backup owner lists risks revealing org-level staffing details
Data quality: incomplete calendar/incident history will bias simulations
Adoption risk if simulator adds overhead to PM workflow
mitigations: Start with read-only recommendations and require manual confirmation before any assignment change
Limit backup owner visibility to named leads and role placeholders; run security review prior to broader rollout
Seed simulator with conservative availability assumptions and allow PMs to override profiles
Ship pilot to three willing initiatives and collect quantitative adoption metrics before scaling
